influences.name: Alex Brettin / Mild High Club
influences.context: I think we both have very different musical upbringings – it's just that we arrive in this very similar place... I'm always just kind of fucking around, but I'm curious, too, and I think Alex's background is the sort of thing I'm fascinated by.
